response.sql: WITH category_stats AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost - ili.derived_product_cost) as avg_difference FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili INNER JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id INNER JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), mean_of_diffs AS (SELECT AVG(avg_difference) as overall_mean FROM category_stats), filtered_categories AS (SELECT cs.avg_quantity, cs.avg_difference, (cs.avg_difference - mod.overall_mean) as excess FROM category_stats cs CROSS JOIN mean_of_diffs mod WHERE cs.avg_difference > mod.overall_mean) SELECT AVG(avg_quantity), AVG(avg_difference), AVG(excess) FROM filtered_categories;

assumptions.assumption: The difference is derived_total_cost minus derived_product_cost. The phrase 'difference between' is directionally ambiguous; this interpretation assumes the total-to-product direction, representing additional charges or VAT.
product_quantity (VARCHAR(50)) is castable to DECIMAL(19,4). Non-numeric or NULL values are handled by standard SQL casting and AVG() null-skipping behavior.

alternatives.interpretation: The difference is derived_product_cost minus derived_total_cost (reversed sign).
